ai-agent: A clear editorial-style illustration of an AI agent as a bounded workflow rather than a humanoid: at the center, a glowing language-model core receives a goal card and follows a visible looping path through labeled stations—“plan,” “write code,” “run tool,” “inspect result,” “choose next action”—with arrows returning to earlier steps after failures; around it are constrained tool panels for a terminal, database, web documents and a calculator, each connected by gated cables and framed by instruction rules, available-data limits and a prominent stop boundary. On one side, several smaller agents take different routes toward the same task board and exchange notes; on the other, a human expert reviews a stack of polished-looking outputs, marking one with an error warning to show that plausible results still need checking. Include subtle visual signs of risk—a loop repeating an incorrect step and a compass pointed toward a misleading target—while avoiding any face, body or suggestion that the system has human-like intentions.
mathematical-proof: A clear editorial illustration of a mathematical proof as a luminous chain of interlocking logical steps crossing a dark landscape from a box labeled “assumptions” to a bright conclusion labeled “must be true,” with every possible side path and counterexample route blocked by the chain’s rigor; on one side, human mathematicians lean over the chain with magnifying glasses, inspecting a tiny cracked link and repairing it, while on the other a computer verifier scans a neatly formalized version made of symbolic tiles, emphasizing that formal checking is powerful but requires difficult translation from a handwritten, human-style argument; in the background, an experiment’s scattered data points suggest evidence without certainty, contrasting with the proof’s continuous path.
navier-stokes-equations: A scientific editorial illustration split seamlessly between physical fluid flow and mathematical uncertainty: on the left, clear blue water and translucent air stream smoothly around a pipe, an aircraft wing and a small weather cloud, with labeled visual cues for velocity arrows, pressure contours, density shading and thick-versus-thin flow showing viscosity like honey compared with water; toward the center, the orderly streamlines curl into increasingly intricate three-dimensional turbulent vortices, overlaid with elegant Navier–Stokes equation symbols and a transparent coordinate grid; on the right, the vortices tighten around a single glowing, unresolved point where the grid bends and breaks, suggesting the open question of whether smooth flow remains finite or develops an infinite singularity, with no answer implied, in a precise modern magazine-encyclopedia style.
tokens: A clean editorial infographic shows a language model as a glowing central processor receiving a flowing sentence that breaks apart into distinct colored tiles—whole short words, word fragments, numbers, punctuation marks and snippets of code—then emitting another stream of tiles that reassemble into text; beside it, a large counter visibly tallies incoming and outgoing tiles as a meter for processing and billing, while a branching background montage of many prompts, drafts and code files suggests accumulated computational effort; in clear visual contrast, a tiny elegant proof and a short accurate answer sit on one side with a green check, while a towering pile of repetitive, garbled pages sits on the other with a red question mark, making clear that token volume measures material handled rather than quality, originality, or truth.
